text: A股三大指数集体翻绿，科创50指数跌超1%，医药医疗、风电设备、工程机械、半导体等方向跌幅居前，沪深京三市下跌个股超2500只。
text_en: All three major A-share indexes turned lower, with the STAR 50 index down over 1%. Pharmaceuticals, wind power equipment, engineering machinery and semiconductors led declines, with more than 2,500 stocks falling across Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing.
